rule_or_step_title: Exclusionary Criteria and Hard Negative Features
phenotype_name: severe longitudinal or transverse limb reduction defects
matching_criterion_description: Presence of phocomelia, ectrodactyly, oligodactyly, or complete absent forearm structures rules out STISS; extremity findings in STISS are limited to non-reduction distal or preaxial anomalies.

rule_or_step_title: Exclusionary Criteria and Hard Negative Features
phenotype_name: generalized dense hypertrichosis and marked synophrys
matching_criterion_description: True dense generalized hypertrichosis and severe, conjoined synophrys are absent in STISS and point away from diagnosis.

rule_or_step_title: Exclusionary Criteria and Hard Negative Features
matching_criterion_description: Disproportionately broad, radially angulated terminal phalanges of the thumbs or great toes are absent in STISS.

rule_or_step_title: Exclusionary Criteria and Hard Negative Features
phenotype_name: isolated visceral malformation without postnatal neurodevelopmental involvement
matching_criterion_description: True isolated visceral malformations (e.g., horseshoe kidney) with normal postnatal neurodevelopment exclude STISS.

rule_or_step_title: Step 1: Screen for Core Neurodevelopmental Invariance
matching_criterion_description: Developmental delay/intellectual disability is obligate (~100% penetrance across cohorts); an individual with entirely normal cognitive development does not have classic STISS.
